The aliases are the entity's full name (with OECD and OECD.AI prefixes, as the field writes it), its former name 'AI Incidents Monitor' (B3 Disclosures: 'previously AI Incidents Monitor'), its address, its acronym AIM (case-sensitive; it also names other things, read and set aside where it does) and its operator's handle OECD.AI (case-sensitive). Admission by reading (§3.4): a candidate is admitted when its sentence or paragraph makes a claim bearing on the monitor (what it is, its method, its definitions, its record, its limits) or applies an archive category to the monitor or to a sourced class; a bare mention, a link or citation list, a use of OECD.AI about another OECD.AI product (the AI Principles, the catalogue of tools, the policy database), or a generic use of 'incident reporting' about another object is not a claim.
